[quote=the_crystalline_empire;61301269][b]January 13, 2028: Negotiations[/b]
The SCSID has summoned the heads of the two main political parties of Rosenmarkke to set a formal election date in order to form a new grand assembly with the plan for a formal left-right coalition to be formed under the banner of One Rosenmarkke in order to bolster unity under the 30th triumvirate.

In return the coalition assembly would look into the dissolution of the triumvirate and the formal centralisation of the triumvirate under Polenne Strømms leadership. However, the leaders of the parties would insist that the centralisation would have to undergo national referendum. [/quote]
[b]January 14, 2028: An Address[/b]

From a specially linked video call aboard the RNS Vnast, Polenne Strømm would address the citizens of Rosenmarkke with tears in her eyes.

In the past few days, it has become apparent that clouds threaten to block the beautiful glow of our glorious nation. But hear me now, these clouds shall not remain for long, our glorious republic shall rise from the East as it was declared by our founding fathers, and through your grit and determination we shall continue striving towards the establishment of a glorious future. 

However we cannot speak in what we must do, but in what we will do. Firstly the triumvirate shall order within thirteen days, snap elections for a glorious new grand assembly, secondly we shall establish a specialised civilian oversight committee over the crooked and corrupt SCSID, which has threatened the stability and safety of our Republic by denying the glorious sun its place among the people. Thirdly, for a safer and more secure society, I am hereby declaring that any protestor who continues to protest shall br heralded as a hero of the state, and shall be awarded $600 and the highest civilian honor, the medal of the Republic, for their role in ensuring the Eternal Revolution!

Glory to Rosenmarkke, Glory to you the revolution!

[b]Deployment to Tirakan[/b]

In the light of recent regional developments, the Federal Government of Valddera confirms that it has received a formal request for strategic and material assistance from our longstanding ally, Greater Tirakan.

While no formal declaration of war has been issued, the security environment within our shared region has grown slight fragile. As partners bound by treaties, doctrine, and shared continental stability, Valddera recognizes that stability in tirakan is inseparable from stability across the East. Accordingly, Valddera will begin coordinated support measures, including logistical assistance, defensive materiel transfers, intelligence cooperation, and readiness coordination under the framework of the Easern Vald-Tiraki Doctrine. Valddera doesn't seek full escalation, however, we will not remain passive where the secuirty of our allies and our region is concerned.

By those means Valddera is also deploying aircraft fighters and logistics, armored vehicles and infantry to the Tiraki borders.

As Defense Minister Ryan Khusanov quotes; [i]"Our Commitment is clear, unity, readiness, and sovereign defense"[/i], in terms of being asked about it from the reporters in the current tensions between Tirakan and Shahban.

Further updates will be provided as developments unfold.

[b]January 6th, 2028[/b]
~~~
BREAKING NEWS

Bayarma the Second, the Khagan of Alaqar and the Crown of Man and Dunmer, was transported to a hospital by ambulance after shed reported feeling chest pain before suddenly falling on the floor. Medical professionals from all over the country are rushing to help the monarch and citizens all over, both overseas and abroad, are waiting with bated breath to see if Bayarma will be okay or not.

Authorities within the House of White Flowers report that Bayarma was speaking to her Minister of Health, Kodir Tulzeki, before suddenly freezing mid-conversation before drifting to the floor while clutching her chest, saying repeatedly, I need help, I need help, I need help. Medical staff and an ambulance was immediately called while the few officials standing in conversation worked to get her outside.

As the situation transpires, the Alaqan government is in temporary lockdown, and Congressional sessions have been paused for now. Her adoptive daughter, Sadryne, is not blood related to House Tabur, and thus if Bayarma were to die, her ascension would mean the end of the Tabur Dynasty. As of now, the people can only hope and pray for Bayarmas sake.

There was only 9 seconds left in the Lamandican Rugby Championship between Reagelerdives and Wichenvidence, with Reagelerdives just getting a try to make the score 27-25. Just as Reagelerdives is getting ready to celebrate, Wichenvidence Fullback Alejandro Otsedia lateraled the ball to Left Winger Brumfict Vailswin-Blochent. Vailswin-Blochent found an opening on the left side of the field and with help from his teammates, sprinted 89 meters across the field for the game winning try as time expired. Wichenvidence wins 27-30.

[spoiler=Trade deal finalised between Wellassona and Valddera]
[i]Wellassonan National News - Новеллсти Нациоьнлыы Веласоньый. Thursday, 6 January, 2028[/i]

Earlier today, The Northern Serene Treaty between Wellassona and Valddera was officially ratified. The treaty, which is considered an important step in Wellassonan foreign relations, includes official diplomatic relations between the two nations, a non-agression pact, and established free trade between them. 

Prime Minister Danil Sokolova was pleased at the outcome of the treaty. At a subsequent press conference after the ratification of the treaty, he proclaimed: [i]This deal is a monumental step forward for our nation. For too long, our nation has remained idle and isolationist due to the influences of our past communist regime. That ends today! I sincerely wish President Suleiman, as well as the Valdderan people, all the best, and I hope that our cooperation will continue for years to come.[/i] 

Foreign Affairs Minister Stanislava Poyanmovov also expressed her support for the treaty: [i]This treaty is huge for our nation. May this start a new chapter of Wellassonan-Valdderan friendship![/i]

However, not all politicians in Wellassona are happy with the deal. The Reform the State party, the Far-right party, has been known for its support of a highly reserved approach to foreign affairs, which has been dubbed "Militant isolationism". Kemder Premier Karina Lagounov of Reform the State, who was unexpectedly elected last July, has heavily criticised the deal. She said: [i]The communists in power are relentlessly destroying our culture. By deciding to strike a deal with the Valdderans, they have opened our country to more terrorists and radical Islamists. We must keep to ourselves to prevent a disaster in our nation.[/i] Lagounov, like other Reform the State politicians, is highly against immigration, especially towards Muslims. PM Sokolova critisized Lagounov for her comment, stating: [i]Lagounov's racism and islamophobia knows no bounds.[/i]

The Diet overwhelmingly voted to approve the treaty in a vote of 165-30, with only the Reform the State Diet members and some hardline Conservatives voting against it. As it was passed with more than 62% of the vote in favour, it didn't need the approval of the Senate, though it was very likely that it  would have passed the Senate as well if needed.
[/spoiler]
